compute_first_gradient: compute the first gradient of a score tensor with respect to a node value tensor
compute_hessian: compute the hessian matrix from a first gradient and node value tensor
soft_abs_inverse: compute the inverse of a symmetric matrix using the SoftAbs map with eigen decomposition
compute_eigvals_eigvecs: compute eigen values and eigen vectors of the negative hessian inverse from a score and node value
hessian_of_log_prob: compute the hessian of log probability for a world and node using a transform
